📒 Files selected for processing (1) * `test/extended/cli/debug.go`
--- ## Walkthrough The `oc debug` image-streams test was rewritten to poll for an internal ImageStreamTag (`openshift/cli:latest`), skip conditionally on timeout, and validate debug pod image references against digest-based regex patterns for both istag and isimage resource types. ## Changes **Image Streams Test Polling and Validation** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Test polling and validation logic**
`test/extended/cli/debug.go` | Added `strings` import and refactored "ensure it works with image streams" test to use `wait.PollUntilContextTimeout` to await the `openshift/cli:latest` ImageStreamTag, skip on timeout, and verify `oc debug` behavior against both `istag/:latest` and `isimage/@` resource types by asserting container image references match digest-based regex patterns. Removed prior `configv1` and `imageStreamsCentos` fixture dependencies. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 12
✅ Passed checks (12 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title directly summarizes the main change: fixing flakiness in the oc debug image stream E2E test, which matches the core objective of replacing a brittle external fixture with a reliable internal image and modernizing polling methods. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | All test names in debug.go are static and deterministic with no dynamic information (no timestamps, UUIDs, pod names, node names, or IP addresses). Test titles use clear descriptive strings. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | Test meets all quality requirements: single responsibility, no cleanup required, proper timeouts, meaningful assertions, consistent patterns. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The modified test is properly protected with [apigroup:image.openshift.io] tag. MicroShift CI jobs automatically skip tests with unavailable apigroup tags. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The modified test does not assume multi-node clusters. It uses ImageStream APIs and the guaranteed openshift/cli payload image with no worker node requirements. SNO-compatible. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only test code (test/extended/cli/debug.go), not deployment manifests, operator code, or controllers. The topology-aware scheduling constraint check is not applicable to test-only changes. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | No process-level stdout writes found. All code is within Ginkgo test blocks where stdout is intercepted by framework. No OTE Binary Stdout Contract violations detected. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No IPv4 assumptions or external connectivity found. Test uses cluster-internal OpenShift image streams (openshift/cli:latest) only. IPv6 and disconnected-network compatible. |
